title: Cardinal Roadside Assistance: Vehicles and Drivers Served
content:
Underwriting guide, Cardinal Roadside Assistance, section on the vehicles and drivers an option serves.

## Terms by option

| Option | Only the scheduled vehicle is serviced | Any permitted driver of the scheduled vehicle may use the service | Motorhome or attached trailer serviced and towed | Heaviest gross vehicle weight rating serviced for a motorhome or trailer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | Yes | Yes | No | 0 lbs (not covered) |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | Yes | Yes | No | 0 lbs (not covered) |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | Yes | Yes | No | 0 lbs (not covered) |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | Yes | Yes | No | 0 lbs (not covered) |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | Yes | Yes | No | 0 lbs (not covered) |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | Yes | Yes | Yes | 26000 lbs |

## What the terms mean

1. **The vehicle.** On every option, service is given only to the vehicle the option is scheduled on.
2. **The driver.** On every option, the coverage follows the vehicle: service is available to any permitted driver of that scheduled vehicle, not only to the named insured.
3. **Motorhomes and trailers.** Only Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer services and tows a motorhome or an attached trailer, and only up to a gross vehicle weight rating of 26000 lbs. On the other options a weight rating of 0 lbs means motorhome and trailer service is not covered.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

| Case | Option | Outcome under these terms |
|---|---|---|
| Named insured's spouse, driving the scheduled car with permission, has a dead battery | Any option | Served: the coverage follows the scheduled vehicle |
| Named insured calls for a car that is not the vehicle the option is scheduled on | Any option | Not served under that vehicle's option |
| Motorhome with a 22000 lbs weight rating needs service | Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | Within the 26000 lbs limit |
| Motorhome with a 30000 lbs weight rating needs service | Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | Above the 26000 lbs limit |
| Attached trailer needs a tow | Cardinal Roadside Premier | Not covered on this option |

Weight ratings in the cases are illustrative inputs.
